answer: Plant each new identity in a shared garden with one job slot, bought for 20,000 POA. A slot grows only after a verified job completes, so capacity is earned, not claimed; a fake that never works stays on the ledge with one slot forever. Audits are rare as opal and random: a fake loses all slots, its fee burns, and its sponsor loses half its own slots. Planting 1,000 fakes costs 20,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays 20,000 once and grows by working. Limitation: a genuine newcomer with urgent capacity is throttled until it earns its slots.
